title.tagline: A game of deduction and pursuit across the city

runner.name: Play as Runner
runner.description: Hop from building to building and evade the CPU police for 11 rounds

police.name: Play as Police
police.description: Search buildings with 3 helicopters and track down the CPU runner

both.name: 2 Players
both.description: Share one device and take turns as the runner and the police

basics.heading: Basics
basics.body: Before the game starts, the runner hides in any building. Each round, the runner moves first, then the police. The runner wins by staying hidden for 11 rounds; the police win by finding the runner with 3 helicopters.

runner.heading: The Runner
runner.body: Each round, move to a building directly above, below, left or right (no diagonals). Moving leaves a trace in the building you left, and you can never re-enter a building with a trace. If you have nowhere to go, you are caught (surrounded).

police.heading: The Police
police.body: Pick a helicopter, then either Move (to an adjacent intersection) or Search (one of the 4 surrounding buildings). The round ends when all 3 have acted. You place the helicopters on any intersections at the start.

traces.heading: Traces and Deduction
traces.body: A search finds either the runner or a trace. The 1st trace (yellow) marks the start point and the 6th trace (red) marks where the runner was after 5 moves; only these two show their number. Connect the traces to work out where the runner is now.

settings.title: Settings
settings.quitConfirm: End this game and return to the title screen?

reason.arrested: Arrested — the police found the runner
